description: A line range within a file change, optionally with the changed content. Populated on both write paths: the hook expands tool_response.structuredPatch into real hunks (body capped at 4000 chars, 100 hunks per change, so a generated-file rewrite cannot land a megabyte per row), and the manual path takes them from gm file-change add --ranges, which is where the live population comes from
name: File Change Range

properties.description: Range start line — a real line number from a structuredPatch hunk or a --ranges argument
properties.name: Line Start

properties.description: The hunk body or an authored note for the range
properties.name: Changed Content
